Your typical day will involve a variety of opportunities in a fast-paced environment including triaging daily support incidents, desktop and light server troubleshooting, hardware and software installation, upgrades, and transformative projects.
eligibility_evidence: As a Systems Engineer – Client Services (On-Site), you will work with the some of the latest technology and a myriad of clients in an organization that fosters an ownership culture, in which every employee takes personal responsibility for ECI’s success.
The successful Systems Engineer – Client Services (On-Site) will “see the world through the eyes of the customer” delivering technical support to our clients in the financial services industry.
In this onsite role, you may be designated to one or more of our flagship clients.
The Opportunity: We are seeking an enthusiastic, personable, and qualified Systems Engineer – Client Services (On-Site) to join our amazing team!
